Configuration for Git to handle text files and set line endings for shell scripts to LF.

# Purpose
The configuration file specifies text file handling rules for a version control system. The line `* text=auto` sets automatic end-of-line normalization for all text files, ensuring consistent line endings across different operating systems. The line `*.sh text eol=lf` enforces the use of LF (Line Feed) line endings specifically for shell script files with the `.sh` extension.
